conclusion: Organic tree-to-interface contact must be evaluated using actual XY bead overlap and Z-bearing, not rejected solely because a same-layer projection has a small XY gap. In the user's QQ case, all 20 measured trunk regions had direct interface contact with zero XY and Z gaps: the left tree at Z 6.15 contacts the Z 6.30 interface over 0.966880 mm2, and the right tree at Z 7.20 contacts the Z 7.05 interface over 0.128945 mm2. A bidirectional nearest-point short-link experiment was rejected because it changed QQ from 149 to 197 support paths and 127 to 142 interface paths, including 1 to 11 interface paths at Z 0.75 by retaining fragments that the detached-interface filter had removed. The restored implementation preserves the direct ordinary/sharp-tail contacts and normalized segment-bearing cleanup, matches every previously verified toolpath on all three models, and preserves the configured 0.15 mm model-to-contact Z gap.
